cpcv.title: Run CPCV validation
cpcv.summary: Combinatorial purged CV + trial grid (DSR/PBO). Family, raw inputs, target, and horizons come only from the immutable model spec; the linked training dataset is read-only.
cpcv.frozenContractHint: CPCV retrains every fold from the model version's linked frozen dataset. The request cannot override model family, input contract, target label, label horizon, or prediction horizon.

cpcv.incomplete: The linked training dataset and runtime config are required.
cpcv.dualTrackHint: Publish requires a single-path backtest (turnover / tail loss / max drawdown) and a CPCV path set (median rank IC / DSR / PBO).
cpcv.sellDualTrackHint: Sell publish requires a lot-level CPCV path set (activity-only lot-native Sharpe / DSR / PBO / rank IC, max drawdown, tail loss, and baseline uplift vs exit-at-first). Empty calendar buckets are never zero-padded. There is no single-path Buy-style backtest for this family.
cpcv.sellSummary: Sell CPCV uses the exact family, target, horizons, and inputs frozen by the model spec, plus a residual-shares state machine (stops on path divergence after partial exit) and activity-only lot-native returns for DSR/PBO.

workflow.label: Config governance workflow
workflow.saveDraftSummary: Save a new immutable policy Revision without activating it.
workflow.validateSummary: Run typed validation, semantic validation, and every consumer dependency preflight.
workflow.approveSummary: Approve this exact Revision and content hash.
workflow.activateSummary: Atomically switch with CAS. Decisions already in flight retain their old snapshot.
workflow.rollbackSummary: Explicitly activate a historical Revision while preserving the complete rollback audit chain.
workflow.rollbackNotice: You are preparing an explicit rollback. The historical Revision must be re-preflighted, approved, and CAS-activated.
workflow.noAutomaticActivation: Every step is audited independently; creation never auto-activates.

modelRouting.description: Select only immutable published artifacts with a compatible side and scope. Free-text IDs are not accepted.

operationalControl.title: Immediate operational control
operationalControl.description: Runtime mode, settlement write policy, and the kill switch share one atomic Revision. An authorized administrator can act independently; every transition requires a reason and appends immutable audit evidence.
operationalControl.unavailable: Authoritative runtime state is unavailable, so every control action remains disabled.
operationalControl.restricted: The system is operating under a restriction
operationalControl.quantModeDescription: Controls report-only, semi-automatic, and automatic execution boundaries. Upgrades run backend preflight.
operationalControl.settlementPolicyDescription: Controls creation of new settlement chain submissions. Existing submissions always continue recovery and reconciliation.
operationalControl.killSwitchDescription: Blocks new execution or permits exits only. Clearing an emergency halt requires explicit acknowledgement.
